whatIsSection.title: What Is a Local Business Partner?
paragraphs: A local business partner (also called a local sponsor) is a UAE national or UAE-owned company holding 51% of shares in a mainland business while the foreign investor holds 49%.

This arrangement exists for certain commercial and industrial activities in the UAE mainland. Unlike individual sponsorship, a corporate sponsor provides more professional legal structure and binding contracts.

Through structured nominee agreements and side agreements, you legally maintain 100% control over business operations, finances, and decision-making. This is an effective and compliant means to access Dubai's mainland economy.

items.title: Corporate Sponsor
items.description: A UAE-based company (100% Emirati owned) holds 51% of shares in your mainland business. Provides professional legal structure, binding contracts, and nominee arrangements allowing full control.

items.title: Individual Sponsor
items.description: An Emirati national holds 51% of shares as an individual. Similar to corporate sponsorship but with a person rather than a company. Requires thorough background checks and legal safeguards.

items.title: Local Service Agent
items.description: An Emirati national or UAE-owned company acts as administrative liaison with government departments. Holds ZERO shares — you retain 100% ownership. Required for Professional Licenses and Branch Offices.

sidebarCard.whatsappMessage: Hi! I have a question about UAE Local Business Partner.

items.q: Is a Local Business Partner compulsory for all businesses in Dubai?
items.a: No. Since 2021 reforms, most mainland business activities allow 100% foreign ownership. Local sponsors are required only for specific commercial or industrial activities. Professional services and Free Zone companies can enjoy 100% ownership.

items.q: What is the difference between a Local Partner and a Local Service Agent?
items.a: A Local Partner (Sponsor) holds 51% legal shares in your company. A Local Service Agent (LSA) holds ZERO shares — they only act as an administrative liaison with government departments for a fixed annual fee.

items.q: Can I retain 100% control with a Local Partner?
items.a: Yes. Through structured nominee agreements, Power of Attorney, and side agreements, you retain 100% operational, financial, and managerial control. The sponsor is a silent partner with no involvement.

items.q: How much does a Local Partner cost?
items.a: Corporate sponsorship fees typically range from AED 8,000 to AED 20,000 annually, depending on the scope of services and sponsor reputation. This is a fixed fee — no profit sharing.

items.q: What happens if I want to exit or transfer ownership?
items.a: We offer flexible exit and transfer options — sell your business, bring in a new partner, transfer sponsorship, or upgrade to 100% ownership if laws allow.

items.q: Will the sponsor interfere in my business operations?
items.a: No. Our Sponsor Limitation Agreement legally prohibits interference. The sponsor is a silent partner with no access to operations, finances, or decision-making.

items.q: Can I convert to 100% ownership in the future?
items.a: Yes. As UAE laws evolve, many activities now allow full foreign ownership. We monitor updates and help you convert your license when eligible by removing the sponsor and updating your documents.

items.q: What legal documents protect my interest?
items.a: Key documents include MOA, Beneficial Ownership Agreement, Power of Attorney, and Sponsor Limitation Agreement. All documents are notarized and legally binding.

items.q: Does having a local sponsor help with government approvals?
items.a: Yes. Our established corporate sponsors help speed up DED licensing, renewals, municipality approvals, civil defence, and industry regulatory approvals.

items.q: Why choose Setup Zone Dubai for Local Partner services?
items.a: We provide reliable Emirati partners, comprehensive legal documentation, transparent pricing, and end-to-end support. With a proven track record and direct government access, we ensure fast, compliant, and secure setup.
